welcome_title: 👋 Welcome to Orca AI Assistant v3.0!
welcome_desc:
1. Select an AI provider and model (or enter any custom ID).
2. Set your API key via "🔑 API Key".
3. Explore 🛡 Pre-Flight, 🔧 Wizards, or quick actions below. Paste defect photos anytime with Ctrl+V.
gcode_no_warnings: ✅ No critical G-code safety issues detected.
gcode_confirm_label: I reviewed this G-code diff and approve applying it
toast_confirm_gcode: Please check "I reviewed this G-code diff" before applying!
pf_no_checks: ✅ All deterministic checks passed — no risks detected!
slice_none: Slice your model in OrcaSlicer (Slice / Export G-code) — print time, filament weight, purge waste, and Before → After deltas will appear here automatically.
def_subtitle: Pick the symptom and attach a photo (Ctrl+V or file) — AI cross-references your live presets & slice metrics to separate hardware checks from 1-click slicer fixes.
def_notes_lbl: Additional notes (filament brand, layer height where it happens, speed, etc.):
def_notes_ph: E.g.: Printing PETG at 240°C, stringing between thin pillars above 20mm Z...
def_photo_hint: You can also press Ctrl+V directly on this tab to paste a photo from clipboard.
toast_select_defect: Select a defect from the grid above first!
def_desc_seam_blobs: Bulges or pits along the Z-seam
cal_order_hint: Recommended sequence: 1. Temp → 2. Max Volumetric Speed → 3. Pressure Advance → 4. Flow Rate → 5. Retraction
cal_trap_text: After running any built-in OrcaSlicer calibration test, always start a New Project (File → New Project) before slicing normal prints so hidden calibration modifiers don't remain active.
cal_in_height: Measured Height to Best Section / Defect (mm):
cal_in_pa_step: PA Step per mm (usually 0.002 Direct / 0.02 Bowden):

prompt_full_audit: Perform a complete technical audit of the current 3D model on the build plate and active OrcaSlicer profile settings. Evaluate dimensions, first-layer contact area, overhangs >45° and >60°, layer height, walls, infill, speeds, cooling, and temperatures. Point out print risks and provide optimal setting changes in an ```orca-settings block.
prompt_supports: Analyze the plated part geometry: first-layer bed contact area, height-to-base ratio, and overhang areas >45° and >60°. Tell me whether supports (normal or tree) are needed, what Z-distance to use, whether a Brim is needed, and if the part should be re-oriented. Include recommended parameters in an ```orca-settings block.
prompt_strength: I need maximum mechanical strength and durability for this functional part under load. Analyze the current walls, top/bottom shells, infill, line widths, temperatures, and cooling settings, and propose an optimal strength profile in an ```orca-settings block.
prompt_quality: How can I achieve the cleanest possible surface finish, minimal seam visibility, crisp overhangs, and zero artifacts on this model? Suggest exact speed, acceleration, seam, and cooling adjustments in an ```orca-settings block.
prompt_speed: How can I safely speed up printing this model without sacrificing critical quality or strength? Check speeds, accelerations, layer height, and line widths, and suggest changes in an ```orca-settings block.
prompt_filament: Check the compatibility of current nozzle/bed temperatures, fan cooling, retraction, Z-hop, and max volumetric speed with the selected filament and all AMS slots. Propose adjustments in an ```orca-settings block.
prompt_inspect_gcode: Audit the current custom printer and filament Start/End/Layer G-code. Check homing (G28) safety, heating sequence, heater shutoff at end of print, purge line, and OrcaSlicer template placeholder syntax. Suggest any fixes in an ```orca-settings block.
